messages:
mia: noticed a subtle p50 uplift across us-west2-slice-C since 22:10 PST, not full tail but steady. looks correlated with multiple kvcache warmups from a single tenant.
jon: p50? any gpu stalls or just network/nvme?
mia: mostly p50 for short gen routes + slight cpu steal on the node agents. gpu time looks fine. nvme writes increased.
rachel: saw the same; ops dashboard shows ~12 concurrent kvcache-regens originating from tenant-echoing at 22:07 and then periodic retries every ~30s. egress traffic modest but steady write amplification to local disk.
jon: probably their onboarding prefill is using aggressive parallelism. options: ask them to throttle, apply NIC shaping, or do a soft migration to a soft-silo (isolated tenancy within same AZ) for the busy pods.
ben-cost: soft-silo still keeps most resources billable; permanent migration to dedicated slice will materially increase monthly commitments. ping me before any full carve.
mia: can we do a temporary soft-silo with network shaping first? lower blast radius and cheaper than full dedicated.
jon: yes. plan: 1) apply egress shaping 2) create soft-silo label and migrate tenant-echoing workloads with low-priority weight 3) monitor p50/p95 and disk iowait for 30m.
ops-bot: kvcache-watcher: tenant-echoing regen jobs detected (12 workers) at 22:07:12. auto-retry policy 3/5.
jon: commands I'll run (dry-run then commit):```
allocatorctl migrate --from us-west2-slice-C --to us-west2-soft-silo-C --tenant tenant-echoing --mode soft --reason "regressions from kvcache warmup"
netctl shape --tenant tenant-echoing --egress 30mbps --burst 8mb
monitorctl alert --metric p50_gen_ms --threshold 500 --window 120s --notify #eng-infra
```
mia: target success: p50 back below 220ms and nvme_iowait <5ms. if we hit p95 > 900ms we'll rollback and escalate.
ben-cost: guesstimate cost: soft-silo migration for 6h ~ $90, moving to full dedicated slice could be ~$1200/day. approve short soft-silo spend.
rachel: dry-run output: ```
DRYRUN: allocate soft-silo capacity ok (est 15% of slice)
DRYRUN: net shape rules validated
DRYRUN: monitor rule staged
```
jon: committing now.
ops-bot: Migration started: migrator/alpha started moving 6 pods for tenant-echoing at 22:12:03.
mia: seeing p50 drop to ~210ms within 90s. nvme_iowait -> 3.5ms. nice.
jon: will leave soft-silo + shaping in place for 6 hours, then schedule unwind if stable. will also follow up with tenant team to limit parallelism in onboarding flow.
ben-cost: approved 6h window. if we need extension past 12h, need cost approval from finance leads.
mia: filing a short post-action ticket with links to kvcache telemetry and suggested onboarding guardrails. tagging @tenant-echoing for follow-up. :wave:
ops-bot: Note: oncall runbook updated: "when kvcache warmup causes p50 uplift -> consider soft-silo + net shape"
